_comment: Page manifest. build.py renders one output file per entry, and sitemap.xml, llms.txt and robots.txt are generated from this list plus data/site.json. A page reads its content from EITHER data_key (a key inside site.json) OR data_file (a standalone json file under data/). Adding an exam is one new file under data/exams/ plus one entry here: no template change and no build.py change.

pages.llms_note: Company overview, what BiDaFa Ltd builds, and the index of exam reference pages.

Reference page for the FAA Part 107 knowledge test (UAG): question count, time limit, passing score, fee, topic weightings, operating limits, five worked sample questions, every figure cited and dated.
The editorial method: which documents questions are written from, how each question records its source passage, how figures are checked and dated, and how to report an error.
